title: Laser: L3a and L3b variations
desc: Three new versions of the bead train (L3a) and three of the heartbeat (L3b), J: IMPROVE with no note, "3 new variations each".

takes.name: tumbling cubes
takes.facts: see-through cubes with a bright bead inside tumble along a thin core + L3's two rims + sparks

takes.name: bead bursts
takes.facts: trios of beads every 6 ticks, 0.5 blocks a tick leaving, speeding up and stretching, a flash on each landing

takes.name: orbit beads
takes.facts: beads ride the two spinning rims (radius 0.12) round a thin core, winding to the target

takes.name: hose bulge
takes.facts: the beam swells (up to 3.6x) as each lub-dub travels through it at 1.6 blocks a tick

takes.name: shock rings
takes.facts: a light ring per beat slides up the beam; a ripple spreads on the wall when it lands

takes.name: throb
takes.facts: the whole beam swells at once per beat, arm kicks 5 deg, beats 9-8-7 ticks apart
